description: Provision a Google Cloud Networksecurity NetworkSecurityServerTLSPolicy via Config Connector. Fields mirror the networksecurity.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 NetworkSecurityServerTLSPolicy spec.

allowOpen.description: Optional. Determines if server allows plaintext connections. If set to true, server allows plain text connections. By default, it is set to false. This setting is not exclusive of other encryption modes. For example, if allow_open and mtls_policy are set, server allows both plain text and mTLS connections. See documentation of other encryption modes to confirm compatibility.

description.description: Optional. Free-text description of the resource.

location.description: Immutable. The location for the resource

mtlsPolicy.description: Optional. Defines a mechanism to provision peer validation certificates for peer to peer authentication (Mutual TLS - mTLS). If not specified, client certificate will not be requested. The connection is treated as TLS and not mTLS. If allow_open and mtls_policy are set, server allows both plain text and mTLS connections.

clientValidationCa.description: Required. Defines the mechanism to obtain the Certificate Authority certificate to validate the client certificate.

certificateProviderInstance.description: The certificate provider instance specification that will be passed to the data plane, which will be used to load necessary credential information.

pluginInstance.description: Required. Plugin instance name, used to locate and load CertificateProvider instance configuration. Set to "google_cloud_private_spiffe" to use Certificate Authority Service certificate provider instance.

grpcEndpoint.description: gRPC specific configuration to access the gRPC server to obtain the CA certificate.

targetUri.description: Required. The target URI of the gRPC endpoint. Only UDS path is supported, and should start with “unix:”.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: Immutable. The Project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description:
The project for the resource

Allowed value: The Google Cloud resource name of a `Project` resource (format: `projects/{{name}}`).

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

serverCertificate.description: Optional. Defines a mechanism to provision server identity (public and private keys). Cannot be combined with allow_open as a permissive mode that allows both plain text and TLS is not supported.

certificateProviderInstance.description: The certificate provider instance specification that will be passed to the data plane, which will be used to load necessary credential information.

pluginInstance.description: Required. Plugin instance name, used to locate and load CertificateProvider instance configuration. Set to "google_cloud_private_spiffe" to use Certificate Authority Service certificate provider instance.

grpcEndpoint.description: gRPC specific configuration to access the gRPC server to obtain the cert and private key.

targetUri.description: Required. The target URI of the gRPC endpoint. Only UDS path is supported, and should start with “unix:”.
